## What this letter says

Your child Yusuf has an asthma check-up (asthma review).
The clinic has moved.
So his old appointment is cancelled.
He has a new date and time.

## What you need to do

1. Do not go on Monday 9 November 2026. That appointment is cancelled.
2. Go to the new appointment on Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15.
3. Bring all of Yusuf's inhalers. This includes his blue reliever inhaler (salbutamol). It also includes his brown preventer inhaler (beclometasone).
4. Bring his spacer.
5. Bring his child health record (red book), if you have it.
6. Keep giving Yusuf his brown preventer inhaler every day. Do this even when he is well.
7. If the new time is not good for you, call 01632 960 588.

## Dates and medicines

**Dates**
- Monday 9 November 2026: old appointment. This is cancelled.
- Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15: new appointment. It is with the children's asthma nurse (Paediatric Asthma Nurse). The place is Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.

**Medicines**
- Blue reliever inhaler (salbutamol). Bring it to the appointment.
- Brown preventer inhaler (beclometasone). Keep giving it every day, even when he is well. Bring it to the appointment.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What will happen at the asthma check-up?
- How long will the appointment take?
- Where is the Blue Zone in the new clinic?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
